name: Unitree B2-Ex
summary: An explosion-proof industrial quadruped of about 130 kg based on Unitree's B2, rated IP66, for route patrols in gas stations, oil and gas plants, chemical tank farms and hazardous stores. Also offered as an inspection set with explosion-proof lidar, PTZ camera and gas sensor.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found that lists the B2-Ex; QUADRUPED Robotics' quadruped range shows the B2, B2-W and a B2 Fire Rescue, but no explosion-proof model. Unitree's page gives the marking Ex db mb IIB T4 Gb and does not mention ATEX.

notes: Two configurations on one page: the bare B2-Ex chassis and the B2-Ex Inspection Solution with lidar, PTZ camera and gas sensor (heavier, shorter endurance).
Maker says payloads such as thermal imagers, gas cloud imaging, acoustic imaging and robotic arms can be integrated; no arm is included.
Unitree also mentions explosion-proof, mining and coal mine safety applications.
